description: This script is part of OpenWrt firmware, used to control and identify the diagnostic LED status based on system configuration and board data.

methods.name: preinit_match_diag_led
methods.description: Initializes the diagnostic LED based on board configuration JSON files.

methods.name: match_diag_led
methods.description: Sets the status LED to diagnostic mode if the configuration specifies it.

methods.name: get_status_led
methods.description: Determines the current status LED by loading configuration files or falling back to default detection.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Changes LED behavior based on the given state, such as preinit, failsafe, upgrade, or done.
